boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 150 closes the set with a compact 4-column match board — deceptively simple after the Super Hard gauntlet. Dual `6` anchor tiles and left-rail `3` group counters are the only objectives. Green right-arrow pushers on the right edge slide entire rows horizontally, turning this into a sliding-rows game rather than the usual block extraction.
landmarks: Block Out Level 150 closes the set with a compact 4-column match board — deceptively simple after the Super Hard gauntlet.
Dual `6` anchor tiles and left-rail `3` group counters are the only objectives.
Green right-arrow pushers on the right edge slide entire rows horizontally, turning this into a sliding-rows game rather than the usual block extraction.

quickTips: Break the top blue 6 before opening the center-right gap with the second pusher.
Move the bottom blue 1×2 only after the green 6 tile clears.
If the board feels stuck, look for the color with the cleanest path and use that to regain space.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Tap the green right-arrow to slide the upper-right green 1×2 leftward, matching the top red/yellow pair without shifting the blue 6.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Clear the top blue 6 tile by matching the blue column beneath it once the top row thins.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Use the second green right-arrow pusher to open the center-right gap after the first band clears.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Match the middle red/red/yellow band to tick the upper left-rail 3 counter down.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Break the bottom-left green 6 tile by sliding the lower blue 1×2 into the blue/red pair.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Clear the bottom red/yellow/red band to spend the lower left-rail 3 counter.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Tap the right-arrow one last time to eject the final yellow scrap for the board clear.

failurePoints: Sliding the bottom blue 1×2 before the green 6 breaks, stranding the red pair away from the right-arrow lane.
Using the second pusher before the top blue 6 clears, splitting the upper band and wasting a 3 counter.
